title: How an Octopus Changes Color in Seconds
audience_promise: In one minute, viewers can see the real skin mechanism that lets an octopus change colour in seconds.
wonder_hook: How can an octopus change color in seconds?

age_layers.children: See an octopus turn colour, then discover the tiny colour cells beneath its skin.
age_layers.family: Follow one clear chain: skin cells, pigment sacs, muscles, and a visible colour change.
age_layers.deeper: Notice the distinction between the observed colour shift and the documented chromatophore mechanism.

sources.title: Smithsonian Ocean: How Octopuses and Squids Change Color

uncertainty_boundary: This episode explains the chromatophore mechanism documented by the sources; individual colour patterns and behaviour can vary by species and situation.
